description: NaMoSbO₅ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with five equivalent MoO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 80°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.41-2.64 Å. Mo is bonded to four O atoms to form MoO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with five equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 42-53°. There are a spread of Mo-O bond distances ranging from 1.77-1.85 Å. Sb is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Sb-O bond distances ranging from 1.99-2.31 Å. There are five inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Mo, and one Sb atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent Na and one Mo atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to two equivalent Na and one Mo atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Mo and one Sb atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two equivalent Sb atoms.
